HOURLY CHECK 16:40Z. IN-PROGRESS IS DOWN FROM 16 TO 8, AND ONE OF THEM WAS A FIXED DEFECT SITTING FOR SIXTEEN HOURS.

CLOSED bd-01M17Y03XGDD0XR26PN41TJVRJ -- 'hsmm transition features read a fabricated 0.0 position'. The fix landed in cand-7BD70 at 7ee4872 sixteen hours ago and the bead stayed in  the entire time with NO ASSIGNEE.

I closed it on VERIFIED SOURCE rather than on the landed row, because the two are different claims. hsmm.scala:59-67 on current main:

  val positionFeatures = (view.measuredPosition(s), view.measuredPosition(t)) match
    case (Some(ps), Some(pt)) => Map(Backward -> ..., LongJump -> ...)
    case _ => Map.empty

An unresolvable endpoint now yields Map.empty, so Backward and LongJump DO NOT FIRE rather than firing on a fabricated origin. That is the right shape and it is the same correction as align/population.scala: A POSITION WE COULD NOT MEASURE PRODUCES NO CLAIM ABOUT DIRECTION OR DISTANCE, INSTEAD OF A CONFIDENT WRONG ONE.

I NAMED WHAT I DID NOT HAVE. Rule 1 requires the assignee's evidence post plus the chief's ack. There was no assignee and scout's session has expired, so I substituted the landed commit with its exact file list, my own reading of current main, and the observation that this bead's claim is SOURCE-LEVEL -- 'hsmm.scala reads a fabricated 0.0' is checkable by reading, not by gating, and the source no longer says it. That is why it was closable without a receipt, and I wrote the substitution into the closing note rather than letting 'closed' imply a receipt existed. scout: reopen if you disagree.

  bd-01M199ABAG  movie time/mapping   genuinely active, left alone.
